Teacher's son marries transgender person; families approve after court marriage

A love story between the son of a teacher and a transgender person in Begusarai, Bihar, has gained attention. Their relationship, which began as a friendship, led to a court marriage. Subsequently, both families gave their consent, and a wedding ceremony was held according to Hindu customs. Videos of the wedding have gone viral on social media.
